title: Machine Learning Model Training with Complex Sample Survey
summary: A research pipeline exploring survey weights in machine learning by synthesizing 250,000 ACS PUMS-based samples for training pipelines that compare baseline models against survey-weight-adjusted models. It fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer per state to generate synthetic training and test data.
